name: ReadJSONFile
label: Read JSON File
description: Reads the contents of a JSON file from the specified file path.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path to the JSON file to be read.

fields.name: JsonContentString
fields.label: JSON Content (String)
fields.description: The content of the JSON file as a string. Returns "null" if an error occurred while reading the file.

fields.name: JsonContentToken
fields.label: JSON Content (JToken)
fields.description: The content of the JSON file as a JToken. Returns null if an error occurred while reading the file.
